job.title: Warehouse associate
job.description: Receiving, picking and packing orders, and keeping the stock counts. You report to the warehouse lead.

place: The Albany warehouse, 210 Hudson Avenue, Albany, NY 12210

pay.paid: weekly, every Friday, for the week ending the Sunday before
pay.method: direct deposit to your bank account

hours.standard: full-time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. with a 30-minute unpaid meal break

leave: Paid sick leave as New York Labor Law 196-b provides, and 10 days of paid vacation a year, accrued monthly
benefits: Health insurance from the first of the month after 30 days of employment, and a 401(k) plan with a match of 3 percent of pay
conditions: This offer depends on your completing Form I-9 and showing documents that establish your identity and employment authorization by your third day of work
